name: 60516 · Downers Grove, IL
findings: ZIP 60516 (Downers Grove) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60516 (Downers Grove) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60516 (Downers Grove) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
